correctness.rationale: The augmented determinant bound shows global maximizers exactly the O(d) orbit of regular simplices. Decompose every tangent array into skew-symmetric rotation A and tracefree symmetric S, with w_i=A u_i+(I-u_i u_i^T)S u_i. The mapping from tracefree S to tangent normals is injective by unique all-ones relation among regular vertices and has correct dimension. Hessian of -log volume from geodesic determinant twice differentiation is H(S,T)=2tr(ST)-(2d+1)/(d+1) sum_i q_i(S)q_i(T); metric G(S,T)=(d+1)/d tr(ST)-sum_i q_i q_i. The tracefree symmetric space splits into span{u_i u_i^T-I/d} (rank d, eigenvalue 1) and its Frobenius orthogonal complement (eigenvalue 2d/(d+1)). All other null modes are rotations. Compact tubular-neighborhood Taylor formula yields uniform sharp r^2 constants; normal eigendirections attain both.

originality.rationale: Horváth and Lángi prove global maximal volume and equality regular simplex, but those results do not imply the precise Riemannian Hessian, its two nonzero eigenlevels and Morse–Bott stability. Medgyes treats 7/8-vertex dimension-4 volume certificates; Grote–Kabluchko–Thäle scalar random-simplex laws do not resolve directional Hessian. Published SCOPE nine-vertex spherical Hessian concerns different object.
